highlights: Major AI developers are pushing advanced models, including specialized versions for cyber defense and enhanced enterprise features, alongside significant performance and cost optimizations for builders.
The ecosystem for building AI agents and applications is rapidly maturing with new open-source tools for local inference, multi-API routing, and robust state/memory management.

Leading companies are demonstrating strong business growth and expanding global presence, while also focusing on critical aspects like data privacy, ethical AI, and educational integration across various sectors.

agents.title: Perplexity Releases Hybrid Compute on Mac for Private AI
agents.summary: Perplexity introduces Hybrid Compute for Mac, enabling cloud agents to orchestrate tasks with local models, ensuring sensitive enterprise data remains on-device for enhanced privacy and security.

agents.title: AQuA: Agentic Framework for Autonomous Factor Discovery in Finance
agents.summary: Researchers introduce AQuA, a two-part agentic framework for autonomous factor discovery and model development in quantitative finance, designed to prevent self-corruption and enhance reliability in agent-driven research.

agents.title: Belief-Calibrated Optimization with Explicit World Models for Agents
agents.summary: Belief-Calibrated Optimization (BCO) is a new method where agents maintain and revise an explicit 'world model' document to guide iterative source code edits, significantly improving optimization performance across diverse agent tasks by making implicit beliefs explicit.

models.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 with Cheaper Cache Reads
models.summary: Anthropic's new Claude models, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, demonstrate significant improvements in science benchmarks (52.6% on Terminal-Bench-Science) and reduce cache read costs by 75%, offering a 1M token context window.

models.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber
models.summary: Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3.8 Flash and a cybersecurity-focused Flash Cyber variant, both based on the same core intelligence but with distinct safety mitigations, offering specialized capabilities for general and vetted defense applications.

models.title: Meta Releases Muse Voice Transcribe: Real-Time ASR, Diarization, Endpointing in One Model
models.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs introduces Muse Voice Transcribe, a single autoregressive model that integrates streaming ASR, speaker diarization, and endpointing into one system, significantly reducing latency and failure modes in voice applications.

tools.title: Perplexity Open Sources Lily: Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Apple Silicon
tools.summary: Perplexity has open-sourced Lily, a high-performance local inference engine built in Rust with custom Metal kernels, significantly improving prefill and decode throughput for Qwen models on Apple Silicon.

tools.title: Qwen Developers Open-Sources zg: Local-First Search Unifying ripgrep, BM25, Vector Search
tools.summary: Qwen Developers released zg (zvec-grep), a local-first search layer that unifies ripgrep, BM25, and vector search under a single interface, enabling agents to seamlessly navigate from natural language queries to exact line spans.

tools.title: NVIDIA Releases Switchyard: Rust Proxy for LLM API Routing and Translation
tools.summary: NVIDIA introduced Switchyard, an Apache-2.0 Rust proxy and library that routes and translates LLM traffic across OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, allowing clients to run against various LLM providers with a unified interface.

companies.title: Anthropic Introduces Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) for Data Privacy
companies.summary: Anthropic announced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), an architecture designed for zero-data-retention privacy, allowing enterprises to store AI monitoring data in their own cloud while retaining automated misuse detection.

companies.title: OpenAI: ChatGPT Ads Reaches $1 Billion Annualized Revenue Run Rate
companies.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads has achieved a significant milestone, reaching $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate and expanding globally, signaling strong commercial success and broader access to AI capabilities.

companies.title: OpenAI: ChatGPT Connects to Healthcare Data for Clinicians
companies.summary: ChatGPT now securely connects to trusted healthcare data, enabling clinicians to access patient context, medical research, and other industry sources, enhancing clinical workflows and information retrieval.

learning.title: Benchmarking LLMs for Statistical Problem Formulation with StatFormBench
learning.summary: A new benchmark, StatFormBench, is introduced to evaluate LLMs' ability to classify statistical problems and identify relevant variables from informal goals and diverse data, addressing a crucial upstream step in data science work.

learning.title: Kaggle's AI Agents Intensive Recap: 353,000 Learners Build Next-Gen AI
learning.summary: A recap of Kaggle’s AI Agents Intensive with Google highlights a massive no-cost coding course where over 350,000 learners participated in building and deploying advanced AI agents, fostering a new generation of AI developers.

learning.title: Induction and Inquiry via Probabilistic Reasoning over Language and Code
learning.summary: Researchers present a computational model that combines LLM-guided Bayesian learning with language and code representations, effectively reproducing human inductive learning and active inquiry behavior with efficiency and flexibility.
